title: Woman in Mind
wpTitle: Woman in Mind reviews – Vaudeville Theatre

ratings.excerpt: proves as compelling as Julia McKenzie in the original … a master of tragi-comedy … Ayckbourn's production powerfully captures the dark humour, sharp pain and sheer weirdness of this remarkable play … the first half moves so slowly that it drifts, and the audience with it… the conceit remains ingenious, but a lighter-fingered, brisker production might have increased the poignancy of the play … curiously flaccid production
